**Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior** (born 5 February 1992), known as **Neymar Júnior** or mononymously as **Neymar**, is a Brazilian professional [footballer](Association_football "Association football") who plays as a [forward](Forward_(association_football) "Forward (association football)") for [Saudi Pro League](Saudi_Pro_League "Saudi Pro League") club [Al Hilal](Al_Hilal_SFC "Al Hilal SFC") and the [Brazil national team](Brazil_national_football_team "Brazil national football team"). A prolific goalscorer and playmaker, he is widely regarded as one of the best players in the world and one of the best Brazilian players of all time.[[3]](Neymar#cite_note-3)[[4]](Neymar#cite_note-4)[[5]](Neymar#cite_note-5) Neymar has scored at least [100 goals for three different clubs](List_of_world_association_football_records#Goals_and_goalscoring_records "List of world association football records"), making him one of the few players to achieve this feat.[[6]](Neymar#cite_note-6)

Neymar came into prominence at [Santos](Santos_FC "Santos FC"), where he made his professional debut aged 17. Soon becoming the Brazilian's league star player, he won the [2011 Copa Libertadores](2011_Copa_Libertadores "2011 Copa Libertadores") with Santos, being their first since 1963. He was named the [South American Footballer of the Year](South_American_Footballer_of_the_Year "South American Footballer of the Year") in [2011](2011_South_American_Footballer_of_the_Year "2011 South American Footballer of the Year") and [2012](2012_South_American_Footballer_of_the_Year "2012 South American Footballer of the Year"), and relocated to Europe to join [Barcelona](FC_Barcelona "FC Barcelona") in 2013. In his second season, as part of Barcelona's attacking trio with [Lionel Messi](Lionel_Messi "Lionel Messi") and [Luis Suárez](Luis_Su%C3%A1rez "Luis Suárez"), dubbed *MSN*, he won the [continental treble](Treble_(association_football) "Treble (association football)") of [La Liga](La_Liga "La Liga"), the [Copa del Rey](Copa_del_Rey "Copa del Rey"), and the [UEFA Champions League](UEFA_Champions_League "UEFA Champions League").
